newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Shanghai jumps after rights plan.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai jumps after rights plan.

text.p: Shares of First Shanghai Investments Ltd surged HK$0.20 or 45.45 percent to a session high of HK$0.64 a share after the company announced a HK$60 million rights issue plans on Monday.
The shares retreated slightly to HK$0.59 around midday.

"Market makers were trying to boost price to make the rights issue more attractive for investors," said a dealing manager at a regional brokerage. "And that prompted demand from speculators looking for a short term profit."
The finance concern plans a rights issue of 172.99 million new shares at HK$0.35 each. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
